content.short: Polygon Faucet provides developers with free testnet tokens for testing and development on Polygon testnets.
content.description: Polygon Faucet, launched in 2021 by Polygon, provides free test MATIC tokens for development and testing on Polygon testnets such as Mumbai, Goerli, Avail Devnet and Avail Testnet. In a controlled environment, developers can gauge their application's performance without spending real funds, helping them identify and fix issues before a public release and gain a clearer understanding of how the Polygon network operates.
